name: Hu 모멘트 불변량 분석
description: Computes Hu's seven moment invariants to detect shape and rotation anomalies in AI content (Hu, 1962).
mechanism:
이 방법은 computes Hu's (1962) moment invariants and extended affine moment invariants for forgery detection:

1. **기하학적Moment계산**: Raw geometric moments mₚᵧ = ΣΣ xᵖyᵧI(x,y) are computed over image blocks. Central moments μₚᵧ are derived by shifting to the centroid, providing translation invariance.

2. **HuMomentInvariant추출**: The seven Hu invariants (φ₁ through φ₇) are calculated from normalized central moments. These are invariant to translation, rotation, and scaling — properties that enable detection of copy-move forgery where copied regions may be geometrically transformed.

3. **블록-wiseInvariant매핑**: The image is divided into overlapping blocks and moment invariants are computed per block. Blocks with similar invariant vectors but different spatial locations suggest copy-move manipulation.

4. **AffineMomentInvariants(AMI)**: Extended invariants following Flusser et al. (2009) capture affine-invariant features, detecting copies that have undergone shearing or non-uniform scaling beyond simple rotation.

5. **일관성분석**: Moment invariant distributions across the image are analyzed for statistical anomalies. Natural images show smooth spatial variation in moment features, while AI 생성 images may exhibit unnatural uniformity or discontinuities at generation boundaries. The final score quantifies deviation from expected natural moment statistics.
parameters: 분석 유형: 자동 통계\n점수 범위: 0(실제)~100(AI 생성)
source: 디지털 포렌식 및 AI 콘텐츠 탐지 관련 동료 검토 연구 기반.
useCase: AI 생성 콘텐츠를 탐지하기 위한 다중 신호 분석 파이프라인의 일부로 사용.
strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적

references.title: Hu, M.K. (1962). Visual Pattern Recognition by Moment Invariants. IRE Trans. Information Theory.
Flusser, J. et al. (2009). Moments and Moment Invariants in Pattern Recognition. Wiley.
